prompt:

Asset type: Production hero BACKGROUND asset for a website, newly generated from the approved visual reference.
Input image 1 is an appearance and geometry REFERENCE ONLY: a stacked theme comparison with typography. Use its sculpted smooth ribbon material and corner placement. Generate a SINGLE clean background, never the comparison board, never a screenshot, never retain or reproduce any UI.
Subject: exactly TWO distinct abstract ribbon sweeps with graceful large curves and softly shaded overlapping smooth sheet layers, one entering from lower-left, one entering from upper-right. Match the reference's intentional asymmetric relationship and layered material. The upper-right sweep flows off the top and right edges; lower-left sweep flows off the left and bottom edges. Avoid: all text, letters, numbers, logos, icons, buttons, cards, UI, screenshots, navigation, extra sections, theme labels, borders, gutters, watermarks, neon, bloom, stars, particles, violet, magenta, busy decorations, generic waves across the entire canvas.
Composition/framing: SINGLE clean mobile background canvas requested EXACTLY 780x760 pixels, aspect ratio 39:38. This is a new mobile adaptation of the approved reference. TWO much SMALLER ribbon fragments at diagonally opposite extreme corners only. The lower-left sweep must stay entirely in the bottom 18% of the canvas: highest visible ribbon point at left edge y=82%, exiting bottom around x=30%. The upper-right sweep must stay entirely in the top 15%: entering top around x=80%, exiting right at y=15%. The wide middle 67% of the canvas is completely empty white/charcoal ground, including both full-width horizontal zones where the heading and side-by-side buttons will be added. Make the forms small cropped fragments, not huge sheets. Preserve the elegant layered curve material of the reference, but scale it down drastically for this compact mobile framing. Do not draw any actual UI or text. Keep every visible piece of blue only below y=82% or above y=15%.
Color palette and backdrop: pure white #ffffff ground, clean consistent white across central reading area and outer unoccupied edges. Smooth ribbon surfaces use ice blue and pale cyan sheet layers, with one restrained royal cobalt blue leading band/edge. Match LIGHT top panel of reference. Soft studio shading within the blue forms only; no blue tint, grey texture or gradient washing across the center.
